notes.title: VERSION 1.1 - MAJOR UPDATE AND MANY SURPRISES! DIFFICULTY MODES, CHECKPOINTS...
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310576/a361fce03bb6de548d4bb3dbd6ea9658fa6fd208.jpg
Hi everyone,

Thank you for your passionate responses to Gripper! We are thrilled to have you playing our unique hardcore boss rush action among the first.
We have been listening to your feedback and implemented a lot of new features to make Gripper a better experience for everyone. Our first MAJOR UPDATE 1.1 includes: difficulty options, tunnel checkpoints, enchanced consumable interface, more accessible quests, boss behaviour updates, balance tweaks and other quality of life upgrades to the game.
[previewyoutube=tUTj4F3n3tM;full][/previewyoutube]
Starting with the difficulty, we are introducing three new options: Rider, Fighter and Gripper. On launch Gripper featured only one hardcore difficulty mode and these additional options will allow for players of various skill levels to enjoy the fast and frenetic gameplay experience.
In addition, the Tunnels sections now have checkpoints on the Rider and Fighter difficulty options, and the Health Pack efficiency is increased.
Moreover, we've officialy recieved the STEAM DECK VERIFIED and got our Steam Deck HQ rating increased to 5 stars! Basically, it means Gripper PLAYS AWESOME ON STEAM DECK.
Here is the full list of improvements:

 Difficulty Modes Added
 New & Better Consumable UI introduced
 Checkpoints in the Tunnels added
 QTE reaction window increased
 Quests have been revisited and improved for better experience
 Quests Victory screen added
 Shock Tunnel Spikes are more predictable now
 Health Packs refill rate increased, pick up bugs fixed, Health Pack Consumable refill rate fixed
 Boss Shock — shocking attack damage decreased, frustrating notifications won’t repeat anymore
 Boss Anger — various balance adjustments and stuck bugfixes
 Boss Depression — bug fixes and notification count reduced
 Boss Zero — battery visual feedback added, balance improved, save bugs fixed
 Skins Unlock tips added
 Achievements Unlock conditions fixed
 Japanese audio correct detection available

And there are more announcements to come. Please follow us and comment. 

Thank you for support,
Yours Gripper Team

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello cyber-bike riders,

Today’s update is an exciting one. Gripper has a release date!

Join None and Cat-Kit on the 29th of March, when Gripper will release on Steam, Nintendo eShop and Epic Games Store. For more details & wishlisting visit our site: gripper-game.com

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310576/84b5f9bb1b1ad2dc9296ef6930e520c6e01d3739.png

The Heart Core team has been working hard on Gripper for over three years now, so we’re really excited you’ll be able to jump into the game soon. We plan to share some more info about some of the cosmetic progression Gripper offers in our next post. 

Leading up to the release, we’ll also be holding a couple of competitions, where you’ll get the chance to win a digital copy of Gripper. To keep up to date with these competitions, be sure to follow us on Twitter, YouTube, Reddit TikTok, you can also join the Discord server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310576/42ce608cadbb406dd252d1119269d2626b03b306.jpg

And here's our Release Date Trailer on YouTube: Trailer

That’s it from us for now, a short but very exciting update.


We can’t wait for you to experience Gripper for yourself,
The Heart Core Team
